name: MCL Slow Product Auction Lifecycle
hypothesis: A two-hour refinery-margin auction transition has usable MCL expectancy only when the same frozen technical trigger is coupled to a causally owned structural-risk boundary; choosing among three semantic boundaries on discovery and then opening one sealed validation owner tests that claim without threshold rescue.

frozen_signal.slow_owner: completed non-overlapping two-hour Globex blocks in which both 42x RB-minus-CL and 42x HO-minus-CL moves agree in sign
frozen_signal.state_transition: retain the last nonzero slow direction; one opposite transition arms exactly one pending auction
frozen_signal.fast_trigger: first subsequent completed five-minute CL and same-suffix MCL move aligned with the pending direction
frozen_signal.branch: completed CL trend state labels acceptance when aligned and failed-auction reversal when opposed

execution_law.transport: one matched-suffix MCL contract; CL discovers but never substitutes for MCL execution
execution_law.entry: next continuous one-minute MCL open after the completed five-minute trigger
execution_law.same_direction: retain the incumbent; no add and no reset
execution_law.opposite_direction: close and reverse at the same next one-minute MCL open
execution_law.contract_or_clock_reset: close at the last continuous MCL close, clear pending state, and never synthesize a reopen
execution_law.maintenance: close at the 16:55 ET MCL close; forbid new entry after 16:25 ET until 18:00 ET
execution_law.stop_ordering: after next-open entry, test the current one-minute range before MFE; a gap beyond a structural stop fills at the adverse opening price

risk_owners_in_frozen_order.boundary: completed five-minute MCL trigger-bar low for a long or high for a short
MCL close at the completed two-hour slow-auction transition
no structural stop; only opposite slow auction, maintenance, clock/contract reset, or dataset boundary exits

windows.validation: 2025-08-04T22:00:00Z through available tape end, sealed until one discovery owner is frozen
windows.missing_challenge_prefix: 2023-07 through 2024-08 remains unavailable and blocks a crown

discovery_eligibility.cohorts: both directions and both branches must each contain trades and be positive under primary and stress costs

selection_law: Among discovery-eligible owners maximize stress PnL/DD, then primary PnL/DD, then minimize primary intrabar DD. Open validation and full-period PnL only for that one frozen owner; never inspect nonwinner validation outcomes.
validation_law: The selected owner must independently satisfy every discovery eligibility gate on validation. Full available history must then reach primary PnL/DD >=1.5 and stress PnL/DD >=1.0.
control: After selection only, invert the selected full-period directions with identical holding intervals and primary costs; the control cannot select or rescue an owner.
if_no_discovery_owner: Reject this lifecycle family before validation and design a materially distinct oil-auction owner; do not rescue it with thresholds, timeouts, quotas, or opened validation outcomes.
if_development_passes: Preserve as a development reference only. Missing July-2023 history, unseen prospective evidence, runtime parity, native transport, margin, preview, allocation, restart, and safety remain mandatory before any crown or capital authority.
